advisories.summary: Includes fixes for CVE-2026-26313, CVE-2026-26314, and CVE-2026-26315. The geth version-check subcommand was removed.
advisories.action: Delete DATADIR/geth/nodekey before restart so the p2p node key is recreated. The node ID changes, which can break static peers.

advisories.summary: Bugfix release. p2p protocol eth/68 is no longer supported, and the engine API no longer enables plain-text HTTP/2.
advisories.action: Peers that speak only eth/68 will not connect. If the consensus client had trouble with engine-API HTTP/2, this release turns that off.

advisories.summary: The default cache size is 4GB on every network. A debug_executionWitness bug that could corrupt node data is fixed.
advisories.action: Plan for the 4GB default cache. Upgrade if you call debug_executionWitness.

advisories.summary: structLog tracers change field format, and reexec is removed from the tracing config.
advisories.action: Update debug_trace callers. memory words are 0x-prefixed and padded to 32 bytes, storage keys and values are 0x-prefixed, an empty error is omitted, and reexec is no longer accepted.

advisories.summary: The bundled clef signer was removed, and command-line flags deprecated for more than a year were removed.
advisories.action: Install clef from https://github.com/ethereum/clef. Drop these flags if you still pass them: nousb, whitelist, cache.trie.journal, cache.trie.rejournal, v5disc, txlookuplimit, log.backtrace, log.debug, miner.newpayload-timeout, miner.etherbase, mine, metrics.expensive, rpc.enabledeprecatedpersonal, unlock, allow-insecure-unlock.

advisories.summary: Default GOGC changed from 20 to 50. A new database uses Pebble v2; an existing database stays on Pebble v1 until you run geth db pebble-upgrade.
advisories.action: Pass --gogc=20 to keep the old garbage-collection behavior.

advisories.summary: Amsterdam is scheduled on Sepolia at timestamp 1791294816. The Holesky testnet was removed. Release binaries are built with Go 1.27.
advisories.action: Sepolia operators must upgrade before Oct 6, 2026, 13:53:36 UTC. Do not start this release with a Holesky network flag.

advisories.summary: Republish of the 1.17.6 Sepolia Amsterdam build, plus small fixes. Either 1.17.6 or 1.17.7 is ready for that fork. Optional history pruning accepts --history.chain <block number>:<block hash>.
